name: akoya_request-writeup-pointers
_comment: Additive canonical pointers to the current Ready, non-superseded Pre-Site Visit and Final Writeup Word rows. There is intentionally no Site Visit writeup pointer: staff record site observations directly in the Pre-Site Word workspace. Dataverse metadata cannot constrain target artifact type, content type, or owning Request; each service transition must enforce those invariants and update its pointer atomically with supersession.

relationships.lookupDescription: Canonical Ready, non-superseded Pre-Site Visit Word document for this request. Updated atomically with activation and prior-document supersession.
